title: Buddy Johnson's commercial dance band
summary: Sam describes Buddy Johnson's good book and his singers.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Buddy Johnson was another cat that had a good band too. Do you remember Buddy Johnson?
Yeah, he had a good band but it was more of that commercial type band.
That everybody liked. They liked to hear them singers sing those love songs.
You know where you could dance, you know, and hold your girl and slide around. He had them singing. He had his sister singing and he had that boy from Atlanta. What was his name?*
Arthur Prysock came in after him.
Yeah. But a lot of good musicians played in a band like his.
He had a good book, he had a good band man.
